## 2026-08-16 · the box that was impossible became boring

#172's last item said "wire the connector into the page". I went to do it in round 236 and found the seam took only a synchronous connector, while every browser one is a promise — so the box was not undone, it was forbidden. Fixed that layer, and today the same item took twenty minutes and no cleverness: bind the RFC 6962 walk this repo already had, pass it in opts, done. Tomorrow's me: when a small task refuses to be small, stop pushing on it and look one layer down.
